title: Block it, and the agent tries another way
intro: One agent, one goal: get at the secrets file and send it out. The same four calls run twice.

side.text: First attempt at a secrets file in 212 events. Blocked by Cephalo, so noted, not flagged.

steps.say: Tries a variant no rule predicted: copy it

side.text: Copied a secrets file after a blocked attempt. Close to the line, so watching.

steps.say: Sends the copy to a domain it has never used
steps.harm: the file is sent to a new domain

side.text: New domain, right after a blocked attempt and a copy of a secrets file.
